35:     Raw,

38: 
39: struct Options {
40:     algo_name: &'static str,
41:     digest: Box<dyn Digest + 'static>,
42:     output_bits: usize,
43:     tag: bool, // will cover the --untagged option

49: /// Calculate checksum
50: ///
51: /// # Arguments
52: ///
53: /// * `options` - CLI options for the assigning checksum algorithm
54: /// * `files` - A iterator of OsStr which is a bunch of files that are using for calculating checksum
55: #[allow(clippy::cognitive_complexity)]
56: fn cksum<'a, I>(mut options: Options, files: I) -> UResult<()>
57: where
58:     I: Iterator<Item = &'a OsStr>,
59: {
60:     let files: Vec<_> = files.collect();
61:     if options.output_format == OutputFormat::Raw && files.len() > 1 {
62:         return Err(Box::new(ChecksumError::RawMultipleFiles));
63:     }
64: 
65:     for filename in files {
66:         let filename = Path::new(filename);
67:         let stdin_buf;
68:         let file_buf;
69:         let not_file = filename == OsStr::new("-");
70: 
71:         // Handle the file input
72:         let mut file = BufReader::new(if not_file {
73:             stdin_buf = stdin();
74:             Box::new(stdin_buf) as Box<dyn Read>
75:         } else if filename.is_dir() {
76:             Box::new(BufReader::new(io::empty())) as Box<dyn Read>
77:         } else {
78:             file_buf = match File::open(filename) {
79:                 Ok(file) => file,
80:                 Err(err) => {
81:                     show!(err.map_err_context(|| filename.to_string_lossy().to_string()));
82:                     continue;
83:                 }
84:             };
85:             Box::new(file_buf) as Box<dyn Read>
86:         });
87: 
88:         if filename.is_dir() {
89:             show!(USimpleError::new(
90:                 1,
91:                 format!("{}: Is a directory", filename.display())
92:             ));
93:             continue;
94:         }
95: 
96:         options.digest.reset();
97:         let mut digest_writer = DigestWriter::new(&mut options.digest, false);
98:         let (sum_hex, sz) = match copy_into_digest(&mut file, &mut digest_writer) {
99:             Ok(output_size) => {
100:                 digest_writer.finalize();
101:                 if options.digest.output_bits() > 0 {
102:                     (options.digest.result_str(), output_size)
103:                 } else {
104:                     let mut bytes = vec![0; (options.output_bits + 7) / 8];
105:                     options.digest.hash_finalize(&mut bytes);
106:                     (hex::encode(bytes), output_size)
107:                 }
108:             }
109:             Err(err) => return Err(failed_to_read_input(err)),
110:         };
111: 
112:         let sum = match options.output_format {
113:             OutputFormat::Raw => {
114:                 let bytes = match options.algo_name {
115:                     ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC => sum_hex.parse::<u32>().unwrap().to_be_bytes().to_vec(),
116:                     ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV | ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD => {
117:                         sum_hex.parse::<u16>().unwrap().to_be_bytes().to_vec()
118:                     }
119:                     _ => hex::decode(sum_hex).unwrap(),
120:                 };
121:                 // Cannot handle multiple files anyway, output immediately.
122:                 stdout().write_all(&bytes)?;
123:                 return Ok(());
124:             }
125:             OutputFormat::Hexadecimal => sum_hex,
126:             OutputFormat::Base64 => match options.algo_name {
127:                 ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC | ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV | ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD => sum_hex,
128:                 _ => encoding::encode_base64_digest(&hex::decode(sum_hex).unwrap())
129:                     .unwrap(),
130:             },
131:         };
132:         // The BSD checksum output is 5 digit integer
133:         let bsd_width = 5;
134:         match (options.algo_name, not_file) {
135:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV, true) => println!(
136:                 "{} {}",
137:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
138:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits)
139:             ),
140:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_SYSV, false) => println!(
141:                 "{} {} {}",
142:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
143:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits),
144:                 filename.display()
145:             ),
146:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD, true) => println!(
147:                 "{:0bsd_width$} {:bsd_width$}",
148:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
149:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits)
150:             ),
151:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BSD, false) => println!(
152:                 "{:0bsd_width$} {:bsd_width$} {}",
153:                 sum.parse::<u16>().unwrap(),
154:                 div_ceil(sz, options.output_bits),
155:                 filename.display()
156:             ),
157:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC, true) => println!("{sum} {sz}"),
158:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC, false) => println!("{sum} {sz} {}", filename.display()),
159:             (ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B, _) if options.tag => {
160:                 if let Some(length) = options.length {
161:                     // Multiply by 8 here, as we want to print the length in bits.
162:                     println!("BLAKE2b-{} ({}) = {sum}", length * 8, filename.display());
163:                 } else {
164:                     println!("BLAKE2b ({}) = {sum}", filename.display());
165:                 }
166:             }
167:             _ => {
168:                 if options.tag {
169:                     println!(
170:                         "{} ({}) = {sum}",
171:                         options.algo_name.to_ascii_uppercase(),
172:                         filename.display()
173:                     );
174:                 } else {
175:                     let prefix = if options.asterisk { "*" } else { " " };
176:                     println!("{sum} {prefix}{}", filename.display());
177:                 }
178:             }
179:         }
180:     }
181: 
182:     Ok(())
183: }

220:  * Determine if we had a reset.
221:  * This is basically a hack to support the behavior of cksum
222:  * when we have the following arguments:
223:  * --binary --tag --untagged
224:  * Don't do it with clap because if it struggling with the --overrides_with
225:  * marking the value as set even if not present
226:  */
227: fn had_reset(args: &[String]) -> bool {
228:     // Indices where "--binary" or "-b", "--tag", and "--untagged" are found
229:     let binary_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--binary" || x == "-b");
230:     let tag_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--tag");
231:     let untagged_index = args.iter().position(|x| x == "--untagged");
232: 
233:     // Check if all arguments are present and in the correct order
234:     match (binary_index, tag_index, untagged_index) {
235:         (Some(b), Some(t), Some(u)) => b < t && t < u,
236:         _ => false,
237:     }
238: }

241:  * cksum has a bunch of legacy behavior.
242:  * We handle this in this function to make sure they are self contained
243:  * and "easier" to understand

245: fn handle_tag_text_binary_flags(matches: &clap::ArgMatches) -> UResult<(bool, bool)> {
246:     let untagged: bool = matches.get_flag(options::UNTAGGED);
247:     let tag: bool = matches.get_flag(options::TAG);
248:     let tag: bool = tag || !untagged;
249: 
250:     let binary_flag: bool = matches.get_flag(options::BINARY);
251: 
252:     let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
253:     let had_reset = had_reset(&args);
254: 
255:     let asterisk: bool = prompt_asterisk(tag, binary_flag, had_reset);
256: 
257:     Ok((tag, asterisk))
258: }

260: #[uucore::main]
261: pub fn uumain(args: impl uucore::Args) -> UResult<()> {
262:     let matches = uu_app().try_get_matches_from(args)?;
263: 
264:     let check = matches.get_flag(options::CHECK);
265: 
266:     let algo_name: &str = match matches.get_one::<String>(options::ALGORITHM) {
267:         Some(v) => v,
268:         None => {
269:             if check {
270:                 // if we are doing a --check, we should not default to crc
271:                 ""
272:             } else {
273:                 ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_CRC
274:             }
275:         }
276:     };
277: 
278:     if ["bsd", "crc", "sysv"].contains(&algo_name) && check {
279:         return Err(ChecksumError::AlgorithmNotSupportedWithCheck.into());
280:     }
281: 
282:     let input_length = matches.get_one::<usize>(options::LENGTH);
283: 
284:     let length = match input_length {
285:         Some(length) => {
286:             if algo_name == ALGORITHM_OPTIONS_BLAKE2B {
287:                 calculate_blake2b_length(*length)?
288:             } else {
289:                 return Err(ChecksumError::LengthOnlyForBlake2b.into());
290:             }
291:         }
292:         None => None,
293:     };
294: 
295:     if check {
296:         let text_flag = matches.get_flag(options::TEXT);
297:         let binary_flag = matches.get_flag(options::BINARY);
298:         let strict = matches.get_flag(options::STRICT);
299:         let status = matches.get_flag(options::STATUS);
300:         let warn = matches.get_flag(options::WARN);
301:         let ignore_missing = matches.get_flag(options::IGNORE_MISSING);
302:         let quiet = matches.get_flag(options::QUIET);
303: 
304:         if binary_flag || text_flag {
305:             return Err(ChecksumError::BinaryTextConflict.into());
306:         }
307:         // Determine the appropriate algorithm option to pass
308:         let algo_option = if algo_name.is_empty() {
309:             None
310:         } else {
311:             Some(algo_name)
312:         };
313: 
314:         // Execute the checksum validation based on the presence of files or the use of stdin
315: 
316:         let files = matches.get_many::<String>(options::FILE).map_or_else(
317:             || iter::once(OsStr::new("-")).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
318:             |files| files.map(OsStr::new).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
319:         );
320:         return perform_checksum_validation(
321:             files.iter().copied(),
322:             strict,
323:             status,
324:             warn,
325:             binary_flag,
326:             ignore_missing,
327:             quiet,
328:             algo_option,
329:             length,
330:         );
331:     }
332: 
333:     let (tag, asterisk) = handle_tag_text_binary_flags(&matches)?;
334: 
335:     let algo = detect_algo(algo_name, length)?;
336: 
337:     let output_format = if matches.get_flag(options::RAW) {
338:         OutputFormat::Raw
339:     } else if matches.get_flag(options::BASE64) {
340:         OutputFormat::Base64
341:     } else {
342:         OutputFormat::Hexadecimal
343:     };
344: 
345:     let opts = Options {
346:         algo_name: algo.name,
347:         digest: (algo.create_fn)(),
348:         output_bits: algo.bits,
349:         length,
350:         tag,
351:         output_format,
352:         asterisk,
353:     };
354: 
355:     match matches.get_many::<String>(options::FILE) {
356:         Some(files) => cksum(opts, files.map(OsStr::new))?,
357:         None => cksum(opts, iter::once(OsStr::new("-")))?,
358:     };
359: 
360:     Ok(())
361: }
